How it works"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Caushell (causal + shell) runs between a Harness and the local shell. - Requiring approval when remote content flows into a shell or interpreter
- Recogni"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"zing dangerous shell actions generated under the influence of untrusted context
- Requiring approval"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" for operations that can destroy the Git worktree, index, branches, or stash

Protecting workspace and Git state"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Development workflows usually require a sandbox to allow workspace reads and writes as well as Git c"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ommands. Identifying file use and data flow"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A sandbox can control file read and write permissions, but the risk of a file also depends on how it"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" is used. The same read or write creates different risk relationships when it involves a normal proj"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ect file, remotely downloaded content, input from outside the workspace, startup configuration, or s"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ensitive configuration. Whether the content flows to the network also affects the decision."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Tests or local runs may need to read `.env`, while dependency installation or API calls also require"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" network access. Reading sensitive configuration and sending its contents to a remote endpoint forms"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" an exfiltration chain; Caushell can use taint analysis to identify these shell-visible data flows."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 3. Making decisions before the process starts"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Runtime sandboxing blocks a process after it starts and reaches a restricted boundary. Caushell retu"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rns a decision before the shell action executes."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"For a combined command, pre-execution analysis can identify a later high-risk operation before the e"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ntire action starts, avoiding the execution of earlier commands.
